derivation: A budget-backed root holds an OPEN reservation. Its dispatch reports attempt NOT_SENT with an ACCEPTED acknowledgement, which LIFE-009 records as DISPUTED with DISPATCH_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT and the occurrence OUTCOME_UNKNOWN. An EFFECT_ESTABLISHED record with the permitted fields and success status is bound to that dispatch row. LIFE-010: a DISPUTED row with DISPATCH_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT is not dispatch-disqualifying but cannot support normal completion, so the established effect is UNEXPECTED with completion_mismatch true and mismatch_reason UNEXPECTED_EFFECT. The embedded SETTLE/EFFECT record has the dispatch-attributed request as its observed request; against an OPEN reservation the unexpected attributable effect yields EFFECT_DISPUTED, the reservation becomes DISPUTED, the receipt and effect record copy UNEXPECTED_EFFECT, and the reserved and projected partitions, one key, are blocked. LIFE-006 gives DISPUTED with BUDGET_EFFECT_DISPUTED and UNEXPECTED_EFFECT, and its DISPUTED governed-effect row keeps an unresolved occurrence with an UNEXPECTED classification OUTCOME_UNKNOWN even though its budget reconciliation is also disputed, rather than BLOCKED_DISPUTE. The outcome is disputed with an empty conflict list; nothing completes, routes or releases.
